allot.subject: Issue of Securities
allot.text: Sudarshan Pharma Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of Securities - In continuation of the Company''s letter dated 30/Oct/2026 (ref. no. SPIL/CS/2026-2027/72), the Board of Directors at its Meeting held on 29/Oct/2026 have approved the proposal to raising of funds through issue and allotment of Convertible Warrants upto an amount not exceeding Rs.72 Crores, each warrant convertible into 1 equity share of Re1/- each, on a preferential basis to Mr. Hemal Mehta and Mr. Sachin Mehta, Promoters of the Company.
